quests.question: Our driver was so _____ that he pulled up at 7:00 exactly, not a minute early and not a minute late.
quests.explanation: Arriving at the exact agreed time is the key clue. Punctual means arriving or doing things at the right time.

quests.question: Dan tends to _____ when he tells stories: a small fish becomes a monster, and a ten-minute wait becomes an hour.
quests.explanation: Turning small things into huge ones is the definition of making something sound bigger than it is. To exaggerate is to describe something as greater than it really is.

quests.question: The courier wrote 'handle with care' on the parcel because the glasses inside were extremely _____.
quests.explanation: A 'handle with care' label is used for items that break easily. Fragile describes something easily damaged or broken.

quests.question: We chose the flat because it is so _____: the station, a supermarket and the school are all within five minutes' walk.
quests.explanation: Having everything useful close by makes daily life easy. Convenient means suited to your needs and saving time or effort.

quests.question: The whole office felt _____ after the announcement; nobody joked, and even the lights seemed dimmer than usual.
quests.explanation: No jokes and a dim feeling point to a low, heavy mood. Gloomy describes a place or mood that is dark and depressing.

quests.question: Claire has two small children and a full-time job, but she somehow manages to _____ without ever losing her smile.
quests.explanation: Handling a demanding life while staying cheerful is exactly what this verb describes. To cope is to deal successfully with a difficult situation.

quests.question: When his phone rang loudly in the middle of the funeral, Jamal went bright red and felt deeply _____.
quests.explanation: Blushing after causing a disturbance in a quiet, serious moment is a classic sign of shame in public. Embarrassed means uncomfortable and self-conscious.

quests.question: The seller swore the watch was _____, but the missing serial number made me think it was a copy.
quests.explanation: The buyer's suspicion that it is a copy shows what the seller was claiming. Genuine means real and not an imitation.

quests.question: The children were _____ to open their presents; they had been awake since five o'clock.
quests.explanation: Waking at five shows how much they were looking forward to it. Eager means very keen and impatient to do something.

quests.question: If I ask Kim to do something, it always gets done on time; she is the most _____ person on our team.
quests.explanation: Tasks always completed on time show that others can trust her. Dependable means reliable and trustworthy.

quests.question: Seeing his friend's new motorbike, Tariq couldn't hide his _____; he had wanted one for years.
quests.explanation: Wanting something for years and seeing someone else get it creates a sense of longing mixed with resentment. Envy is the feeling of wanting what another person has.

quests.question: The restaurant has a _____ for fast service, and customers say they have never waited more than ten minutes.
quests.explanation: What customers say over time shapes how the restaurant is generally seen. A reputation is the opinion people commonly hold about someone or something.

quests.question: When the salesman promised that the cream would take ten years off her face within a week, Rosa was _____.
quests.explanation: The promise sounds too good to be true, so she doubts it. Sceptical means not easily convinced and inclined to doubt.

quests.question: Even as a junior clerk, Wei talked about running the company one day and studied for a business degree in the evenings. Everyone knew how _____ she was.
quests.explanation: Planning to reach the top and working extra hours towards it shows a strong drive to succeed. Ambitious means determined to achieve big goals.

quests.question: Her desk was so _____ with papers, mugs and tangled cables that she couldn't find her keyboard.
quests.explanation: A pile of random items hiding the keyboard shows a messy, overfilled space. Cluttered means covered with too many things.

quests.question: Fuel prices have _____ this year: petrol now costs nearly twice what it did last January.
quests.explanation: Costing nearly double means the price shot up quickly. To soar is to rise rapidly and to a high level.

quests.question: 'When she heard she had won the scholarship, she was over the moon.' What does this expression mean?
quests.explanation: Winning a scholarship is great news, and 'over the moon' is a vivid way to show joy. The phrase has nothing to do with the actual moon.

quests.question: Nina kept glancing at the clock and tapping her foot while Sam explained his plan for the third time. What was she most likely feeling?
quests.explanation: Clock-watching and foot-tapping are classic signs that someone wants you to hurry up. Impatient means unable to wait calmly.

quests.question: The trip wasn't planned at all; it was completely _____. We saw the sunny forecast on Friday and drove to the coast that afternoon.
quests.explanation: Deciding and leaving on the same day shows there was no preparation. Spontaneous means done on impulse, without planning.

quests.question: Although he earned very little, Mr Alvarez was extremely _____: he donated a whole month's pay to the flood fund.
quests.explanation: Giving away a month's income is an unusually giving act. Generous describes someone who freely shares money or time.

quests.question: The new manager refuses to _____ lateness: anyone who arrives after nine gets a formal warning.
quests.explanation: Giving a warning shows lateness is not accepted. To tolerate something is to allow it without protest.

quests.question: Two cyclists who saw the collision gave statements to the police as _____.
quests.explanation: People who saw an event and tell the police what happened are called witnesses. They were present at the scene but not directly involved.

quests.question: At first Lily refused to go skiing, but her brother kept describing how much fun it was until he finally _____ her.
quests.explanation: His repeated talking changed her mind in the end. To persuade is to convince someone to do something.

quests.question: Taking a coat was a _____ decision; an hour later it poured with rain.
quests.explanation: The decision turned out well because it prepared her for the weather. Sensible means showing good judgement.

quests.question: The two departments will _____ on the product launch, sharing designers and a single budget.
quests.explanation: Sharing designers and money shows they will work jointly. To collaborate is to work together towards the same goal.

quests.question: At the party she knew nobody, so she stayed near the door with her drink, feeling distinctly _____.
quests.explanation: Standing apart among strangers is a typical sign of not fitting in. Awkward describes feeling uncomfortable in a social situation.

quests.question: The author's main _____ in the essay is that cities need more green space to protect public health.
quests.explanation: The sentence states the central claim the writer is trying to prove. An argument in an essay is a point supported with reasons.

quests.question: The map was so _____ that following it led us in a complete circle back to the hotel.
quests.explanation: A map that sends you the wrong way gives a false idea of the route. Misleading means causing someone to believe something untrue.

quests.question: These boots are very _____; I've worn them every day for six years and they still look almost new.
quests.explanation: Heavy daily use for six years without wear shows they last. Durable means able to withstand wear and tear.

quests.question: When the doctor told him the test results were clear, he let out a long breath of _____.
quests.explanation: The long breath after good news shows worry draining away. Relief is the feeling after a fear or stress has ended.
